firstScreen.notes: 1440-first.jpg: dark cover, sticker label over the slider photo shows the signature at 0 scroll, phone in header + primary button, proof line with SAMPLE RATING, cream band peeks ~45px. But the h1 'Read the label before you sign.' names no trade and no place; trade+city sit only in the eyebrow (-1.0 from the 9 anchor, partly earned back by the concept-specific composition). 390-first.jpg: h1 2 lines, both actions above the fold, call bar present.

distinctiveness.notes: Peel-back sticker (yellow top rule + dog-ear) appears in hero, #label, service cards, price tags, reviews, form card and footer (1440-full.jpg); dark/yellow palette and Red Hat Display clearly differ from siblings A (serif on cream) and C (condensed centred) in A/C 1440-first.jpg. Deductions: on cards the dog-ear is a 12px corner triangle that never peels in any frame, so the motif is decoration there (-0.5, 1440-scroll-25.jpg); '01..08' section numbers plus 'OPENING 01..07' card numbers are the decorative-numbering tell (-0.5, 1440-scroll-25.jpg, 1440-scroll-75.jpg). Services band is a standard photo + 3-col card grid.

type.notes: Red Hat Display 800 with tight tracking + Martian Mono values is a strong pair (1440-first.jpg, crop of 1440-full.jpg #label). Deductions: straight apostrophes in h2s ('you'd', 'it's', 'We'll', 'What's the job?') while the prices lead uses a curly one (-0.5, 1440-scroll-50.jpg, 1440-full.jpg #contact); 3+ tiny tracked mono caps labels in one view in #compare (OPENINGS ON THE HOUSE, WHO PUTS THE SHUTTERS UP?, WEEKS AWAY IN SEASON, STORM-DAY WORK, WHO DOES IT, THE LOOK) and the 'WHAT MOVES IT' price-tag text looks ~11px (-0.5, 1440-full.jpg).

layout.notes: 1440-full.jpg: tones alternate dark/paper/dark/paper/photo/yellow/dark/paper/dark/paper/dark, full-bleed rain break, asymmetric compare (controls | paper | dark column), yellow order-by band is a real density change. Deductions: services band is the generic 'photo tile + 3-col card grid' shape (1440-scroll-25.jpg); #label right column ends ~300px above the sticker's bottom leaving dead width, and the 1440-scroll-50.jpg break leaves the right two thirds empty under a caption chip (-0.5).

photo.notes: 1440-scroll-25.jpg: antique iron lever and lock plate on a weathered oak door is off-topic for Naples impact doors (European heritage door, nothing impact or Florida) (-1.0); its saturated warm-orange grade sits next to the cool grey hero slider (1440-first.jpg) and the blue rain bokeh (1440-scroll-50.jpg) (-0.5 mixed grades). Hero slider photo is on-topic but a flat grey interior shot, and the sticker frame is a good concept treatment (+0.5). Captions describe frames honestly.

copy.notes: Real trade nouns and honest hedges: DP +50/-50 psf, missile D, interlayer, 'We don't quote insurance savings', 'Manufacturers and permit offices vary. We confirm your dates in writing.' (crops of 1440-full.jpg). Microcopy under the form and next to the phone. Deduction: hero lead says the sticker has 'four numbers that decide its price' while #label h2 says 'Five numbers' and the hero sticker shows DP/MISSILE/SHGC/ORDER BY/PRICE, three different counts of the same label (-0.5, 1440-first.jpg vs 1440-full.jpg #label). Primary action mostly 'Price it' but also 'Have us read your quote', 'Plan my dates', 'Price 12 openings'.

mobile.notes: 390-full.jpg (#label, ~y 1700): the '+50 / -50' value overprints the 'DESIGN PRESSURE' row label; two texts collide (-1.0, mustFix). 390-full.jpg hero: the photo caption runs under the overlapping sticker and is cut ('A wide dark-framed slider standing open' clipped). Otherwise: no sideways scroll (render.json), call/text/price bar, h1 2 lines, buttons full-width.

a11y.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg and 390-rm-full.jpg show every section, label meanings and timeline in full; static/render clean. Ratios planned in concept hold on screen. Not 9: the small mono captions on paper (e.g. 'Impact glass, cut through' caption in #label, 'WHAT MOVES IT' on yellow, 1440-full.jpg) look light and small enough to be borderline; focus design not verifiable from frames.

motion.notes: Hooks in dist: split lines/chars, clip/scale/fade reveals with stagger, peel signature, range sliders driving the compare, month tabs driving the timeline. But in 1440-scroll-25/50/75.jpg and 1440-full.jpg vs 1440-rm-full.jpg the #label rows look identical: every meaning already visible, every dog-ear the same 12px corner, so the promised row-by-row peel is not visible as a state change in any frame. Motion explains via the tools, not via the signature.

wow.notes: Three useful tools in the thesis' language: the translated label (crop of 1440-full.jpg #label), shutters vs glass with a live 'Price 12 openings' (1440-full.jpg #compare), and the order-by bar with the 'ORDER BY Early March' sticker against the hatched season (1440-full.jpg #orderby). Not 9: the signature moment (the label peeling to translate itself) does not read as a moment in any frame, and the outputs are not something a homeowner keeps (no printable label sheet).

polish.notes: Consistent 2px radius and yellow top rules, designed footer close with the 'LABEL READ. Call' sticker (1440-full.jpg footer), print and forced-colors media present, OG/apple-touch/JSON-LD in head. Deductions: hero photo caption set as a 5-line right-aligned mono column in the sticker margin (1440-first.jpg); hero caption clipped at 390 (390-full.jpg).

mustFix.problem: The '+50 / -50 PSF' value overprints the 'DESIGN PRESSURE' row label at 390; text collides
mustFix.fix: Under 640px stack each label row: name on its own line, value below (grid-template-columns:1fr; value font-size clamp(1.75rem,8vw,2.25rem)), or let the value wrap to a second grid row so the name never sits under it

elevate.move: Make the photography one shoot about openings in Naples light: replace the antique oak door with an on-topic frame (a lanai slider track, a French door to a pool deck, or a window corner with its frame and sill), and grade every frame into the night + label-yellow palette (cool shadows, warm highlights) so the hero, services tile and rain break read as one set; run the services photo through the same sticker frame as the hero.

Re-cut the label for the thumb: on phones the sticker becomes a stack of peel tabs, one row per card, name on top, value large below, meaning revealed under the curled corner on tap, and the hero crops to the sticker only (photo behind it as a tight slice) so the label is the first thing a phone visitor reads.
